Hi Aiden —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side: you mentioned latency targets (~<200ms p50 for user-facing completions), need for private deployment behind your VPC, SOC 2 evidence, and an expected steady-state of ~400–600 rps with occasional spikes. Sounds like the right next step is a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with our ML + infrastructure engineers to walk through:

- current production traffic profile and tokenization patterns (you)
- model selection and quantization options (us)
- deployment topology (hosted vs. private) and VPC peering/egress controls
- monitoring, tracing, and security requirements (audit logs, retention)
- integration touchpoints and mutual action plan

Would you be able to propose 2–3 windows next week (in PST) that work for your team? Please also share the list of attendees and any items you want us to add to the agenda (security artifacts, procurement prerequisites, etc.). I attached a short proposed agenda to this note (proposed-tdx-agenda.pdf).

If you prefer, we can hold the session 75 minutes to allow a live demo of an inference run and a short Q&A. I’ll coordinate internal attendees once we lock a time.

Thanks — look forward to locking this in.

Chloe Martin

Redwood Inference
